sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface immunostaining PME 1461.1 ± 307 (HA immunostaining, Tedman deep receptor scanning)

sources.citation: Tedman et al., Efficient experimental characterization of the GPCRome via deep receptor scanning, Nat Commun 2026 (bioRxiv 2025.09.19.677468, PMC12458215)

sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface display confirmed by single-particle quantum-dot tracking at the plasma membrane of hippocampal neurons; receptor lateral diffusion measured. Agonist-induced confinement and synaptic enrichment observed, indicating the tagged receptor is functional in trafficking assays.
sites.rationale: L5 explicitly states the CFP is at the 'N-terminus part' of D1R (D1R-CFP), and L8 confirms expression in hippocampal neurons for surface diffusion experiments. DRD1 has no signal peptide (topology shows EXTRACELLULAR 1-23 starting at M1), so the N-terminal prepend (insert_after_residue=0) places the tag before M1, the first extracellular residue. The N-terminus spans 23 residues before TM1 (residue 24), providing ample buffer. This is the only extracellular terminus of DRD1, making topology_derived the correct position_evidence class. D1R-CFP construct expressed in hippocampal neurons (7-10 DIV) by transfection; CFP is explicitly placed at the N-terminus of D1R (D1R-CFP). Single-particle tracking of D1R-QD at the cell surface was performed using this construct.

sources.claim: NMDAR, [41] ), we tracked single D1R-QD at the surface of hippocampal neurons transfected with D1R containing at their N-terminus part a cyan fluorescent protein (D1R-CFP) ( Fig. 1A ).
Surface receptor immunoreactivity for non-permeabilized striatal primary dissociated neurons was assayed by incubating with mouse M1 anti-FLAG antibody (Sigma, 1 µg/ml for 15 min).
For culture and tissue experiments, we used Slc6a3 -Cre x Ai9 ( 54 , 55 ), ALFADoR1 mice (this work), ALFADoR2 mice (this work) transgenic P1 to P2 pups and adult (P50 to P60) mice.

literature_notes: L1 (PMC2878344) mentions FLAG-tagged D1R 'previously described' without stating position; L2 from the same paper confirms surface display and is used as the primary clip for the FLAG site. L3/L4 (PMC5459500) describe a C-terminal 3X-FLAG-tagged DRD1 in SH-SY5Y cells; the C-terminus (residue 446) is intracellular (topology 334-446), so this is recorded in other_positions. L6/L7 (PMC4793083) describe the same D1-CFP construct used in L5/L8 (in utero electroporation and neuron co-transfection); they support the same N-terminal CFP site and are subsumed under L5. L9/L10/L11 (PMC11992035): K165 and K167 in ECL2 are covalent labeling sites for an acyl-imidazole probe reacting with native lysines — this is chemical labeling of endogenous residues, NOT a tag insertion. The F-ST-D1 construct contains a SNAP-tag fused to D1R, but the SNAP-tag insertion position is not stated in any ledger clip. The HA-D1 construct has an HA tag at an unstated position. The SpeI restriction site at positions 169-170 is a cloning junction used for subcloning, not a tag insertion site. None of these qualify as pinnable tag insertion sites per the ledger rules. L12/L13 (DOI:10.64898/2026.09.19.752778): cpHaloTag inserted in ICL3 (intracellular loop 3, residues 216-273) — intracellular, recorded in other_positions. L14 (PMC13632744): ALFA tag in DRD1 (ALFADoR1 mice); position topology_derived as the N-terminal prepend, the only extracellular terminus.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal 3X-FLAG tag on DRD1 expressed in SH-SY5Y cells; residue 446 (T) is within the intracellular C-terminal domain (topology 334-446), not accessible for surface labeling.
cpHaloTag inserted in ICL3 (intracellular loop 3, residues 216-273) of hDRD1 to create a chemigenetic dopamine sensor; this loop is intracellular and not a surface tag site.
